ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels covering lateral lobes and 40% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated in the central region and perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black region extends from the fluke base to the median notch. Lateral lobes are predominantly white with discrete circular black clusters (mottling) localized in the mid-left region and linear dark streaks mapping to the mid-right region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous trailing edge exhibits moderate-frequency serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2 to 10 pixels from the mean edge trajectory.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a concave mathematical curve from the distal tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small circular black pixel clusters scattered on the left-lobe white surface; white high-contrast clusters localized on the far right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four distinct, roughly parallel dark linear pixel segments oriented diagonally on the right-lobe white surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, dark-reddish irregular mass on the far left distal tip; crusty white clusters on the far right distal tip; small notch on the left trailing edge span.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique reddish-brown pixel cluster on the far left tip which breaks the grayscale intensity pattern of the fluke.
